url.description: A complete Google web search URL to run instead of query, such as 'https://www.google.com/search?q=crm&gl=us&num=30'. cloro keeps q, gl, hl, uule, num (result depth, in pages of 10, at most 10 pages), start, tbs and safe. Needs gl in the URL, or country or gl beside it.
